product_overview: VitalScan is a health monitoring web application that lets users register, log in, and use their camera to perform a live health scan. It presents health metrics, scores, reports, charts, and historical records in a dashboard experience.
core_goals: Create an account and sign in to access personalized health data
Use the camera to run a live health scan and view health metrics
Review health scores, charts, and the latest health report
Browse previously saved health reports in history

features.name: User Registration and Login
features.description: Users can create an account, sign in with email and password, and access the application after authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Enter a valid email and password -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created confirmation and proceed to sign in
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication validation message

features.name: Email Verification Enforcement
features.description: Users must have a verified email before continuing into the app after login.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password for an unverified account -> Submit the login form -> See a message indicating verification is required before access

features.name: AI Health Scan via Camera
features.description: Users can start a live camera-based health scan and provide contextual inputs that influence the scan results.
user_flows: Navigate to /scan -> Allow camera access -> Enter age, sleep hours, and stress level -> Start the scan -> See live health metrics begin to populate
Navigate to /scan -> Deny camera access -> Attempt to start the scan -> See a permission-related message preventing the scan from continuing
Navigate to /scan -> Allow camera access -> Leave required inputs incomplete or invalid -> Attempt to start the scan -> See form validation feedback

features.name: Health Metric Display and Score Calculation
features.description: Users can view scan results including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen, stress, and an overall health score with risk context.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> View health cards for heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen, and stress -> View the health score and risk summary
Navigate to /report -> Review the latest scan results -> Observe the detailed metric values and health score breakdown

features.name: Charts and Visualizations
features.description: Users can inspect visual representations of their health data on the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Review the health charts -> Compare metric trends and summary visuals

features.name: Report Saving and Latest Report Viewing
features.description: Users can save scan results and open the most recent report for detailed review.
user_flows: Navigate to /scan -> Complete a scan -> Save the report -> Navigate to /report -> See the latest saved health report with values displayed

features.name: Report History
features.description: Users can browse their historical health reports from storage.
user_flows: Navigate to /history -> View the list of saved reports -> Open the history details for past health records
Navigate to /history -> View an empty state when no reports exist

features.name: PDF Export of Reports
features.description: Users can export a health report into a PDF file for sharing or offline use.
user_flows: Navigate to /report -> Open the latest report -> Export the report as PDF -> See the downloaded PDF file

features.name: Site Navigation
features.description: Users can move between the main public and authenticated sections using the application's navigation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Use the navigation links to open /about -> Return to / -> Open /login -> Open /register
Navigate to /dashboard -> Use the navigation links to open /report -> Open /history -> Return to /dashboard

pages.name: Home
pages.description: Landing page with Hero, Features, HowItWorks, Stats, Footer components

pages.name: Login
pages.description: Email/password login form with Google OAuth option. Checks email verification status.

pages.name: Register
pages.description: New user registration with email/password via Firebase

pages.name: Scan
pages.description: Live camera feed using getUserMedia, rPPG face scanning for health metrics (heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen, stress). Accepts age, sleep hours, stress level inputs.

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Displays user health data with charts and health cards

pages.name: Report
pages.description: View the latest health report with details

pages.name: ReportHistory
pages.description: View all historical health reports from Supabase

components.Navbar: Navigation with links to all pages

components.HealthChart: Chart component for health data visualization

services.authService: Firebase authentication (signIn, signInWithGoogle, signOut, sendVerificationEmail, register)

context.HealthContext: Global state for health scan data (heartRate, bloodPressure, oxygen, stress, healthScore, risk)

features: User registration and login with email/password
AI health scan via camera (rPPG signal processing)
Health metric display (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2, stress)
Health score calculation with age/sleep/stress adjustments
